description: KNaTi₄(BiO₆)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.12 Å. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.75 Å. Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.29 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, one Na, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
